steps: Commit 1: Build the DataPipeline.Ingress library — IngressStream.ReadNdjsonLinesAsync and IngressStream.Skip helpers, README, unit tests. No behavior change anywhere else.
Commit 2: Refactor CortexXdrXqlClient.ExecuteAsync to return IAsyncEnumerable<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>> using the new helpers. Drop List<JsonElement>, CloneArray, in-memory accumulation.

Commit 2: Refactor CortexXdrFindingsFlow.CollectAsync/PublishCveRowsAsync to consume the streaming source via IngressStream.Skip(nextCveIndex). Remove OrderCveRowsForResume, BuildCveTieBreakerHash, GetJsonSortValue, AppendHashData, CveSortTieBreakerFields, CveStageResult.
Commit 2: Update DryRun probe to drain only the first element of the streaming source rather than calling the old List-returning ExecuteAsync.

Commit 2: Tighten Egress UTF-8 path to validate every record (cheap JsonDocument.Parse-and-dispose on no-newline records), matching the existing multi-line throw shape. Add a unit test pinning the strict contract.

Commit 2: Update CortexXdrFindingsFlowTests for the streaming source shape; preserve all existing assertions (request sequence, checkpoint state, resume from nextCveIndex > 0, cancellation between pages, legacy checkpoint rejection).
